create_linearbn1d_module: create a LinearBn1d module for quantization aware training with given in_features and out_features
build_qat_linear_bn_fused: build a fused Linear and BatchNorm1d module with fake quantization for QAT
convert_float_to_qat: convert a float LinearBn1d module to a quantization aware training module using from_float
convert_qat_to_float: convert a quantization aware training LinearBn1d module back to a float Linear module using to_float
freeze_bn_statistics: freeze batch normalization statistics in a LinearBn1d module to prevent updates during training
